# Bushfire-specific PM~2.5~ (polygons)

This approach, designed for polygonal study areas rather than point locations, used the following conditions to signal a probable firesmoke day:

- dust_merra_2_p75 < 0.5, AND
- dust_cams_p75 < 0.5, AND
- whs_15degreeC < 0.5, AND
- smoke_p95 = 1

The first three conditions were calculated on the mean of the raster cells within the polygon. For the fourth condition, `smoke_p95` was set to `1` if the geometric mean of PM~2.5~ within the polygon was greater than the 95th percentile of means for that polygon, calculated over the study period (in that particular case from 2010-01-01 to 2019-06-30).
